name: Jabin
bio: Jabin was the king of Hazor, which was at that time the most powerful city among the northern kingdoms. Hearing of Israel's victories in the south, he allied with the kings of Madon, Shimron, Achshaph, and others, gathering an enormous army with many horses and chariots, and encamped at the waters of Merom to fight Israel (Joshua 11:1-5). The LORD promised Joshua victory, and Joshua launched a surprise attack; the LORD routed the enemy, and Israel pursued them as far as Sidon, hamstringing their horses and burning their chariots (Joshua 11:6-9). Joshua then turned back and captured Hazor, killing its king with the sword and burning the city — the only fortified city Joshua burned in his entire northern campaign (Joshua 11:10-11).
